title: Apple ProMotion Dynamic Refresh Rate Arbitration & State Machine Specification

discrete_refresh_rates.trigger: Active touch contact, high-velocity fling gestures, 120fps Metal games.
Deceleration ramp-down step 1 from 120Hz scroll gestures.
Standard UI animations, 60fps video playback, web scrolling deceleration.
Native cinema 24fps video playback without frame repetition.
Static reading with minimal UI updates.
Completely static interactive screen (idle user reading book or web article).
Always-On Display (AOD) locked sleep state, driven by AOP via CBAOPEndpoint.

states.name: SWMPR_STATE_IDLE_10HZ
states.description: Interactive baseline state when no user input or animation has occurred for >100ms.

states.name: SWMPR_STATE_INTERACTIVE_RAMP_UP
states.description: Transient boost state triggered by IOHIDEvent tap or pan; pre-arms 120Hz VBP timings.

states.name: SWMPR_STATE_ACTIVE_120HZ
states.description: Peak refresh mode sustaining direct finger tracking, rapid momentum scrolling, and Metal games.

states.name: SWMPR_STATE_DECEL_RAMP_DOWN
states.description: Graduated stair-down state traversing 120 -> 80 -> 60 -> 40 -> 30 -> 10 Hz across hysteresis window.

states.name: SWMPR_STATE_MEDIA_LOCK_24_48_60HZ
states.description: AVFoundation video cadence lock mode matching movie frame presentation (24Hz, 48Hz, or 60Hz).

states.name: SWMPR_STATE_AOD_1HZ
states.description: Always-on display low-power mode with 357,116 lines of blanking, refreshed once per second.

touch_boost_policy.activation_trigger: IOHIDEvent with phase UITouchPhaseBegan or continuous motion gesture.
touch_boost_policy.guarantee: Immediate jump from 10Hz to 120Hz within a single VSYNC boundary without intermediate steps.
